source_caption:
🎬 Fast X (2023)

Fast X follows Dominic Toretto and his family as they face one of their most dangerous enemies yet. After years of surviving impossible missions and powerful adversaries, Dom finds himself targeted by Dante Reyes, the ruthless son of a Brazilian drug lord who was killed during a previous mission. Driven by revenge, Dante creates an elaborate plan to destroy everything Dom loves, forcing the family into a deadly battle that stretches across the globe. As explosive car chases, dangerous confrontations, and unexpected betrayals unfold, Dom must fight to protect his loved ones while facing the consequences of his past. Starring Vin Diesel, Jason Momoa, Michelle Rodriguez, and John Cena, the film delivers high-speed action, spectacular stunts, and intense moments centered on family, loyalty, sacrifice, and revenge.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Crime • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 5.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 21m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Louis Leterrier

✍️ Writers: Dan Mazeau & Justin Lin

📺 Where to Watch: Check Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Fast X (also known as Fast & Furious 10) is a 2023 American action film directed by Louis Leterrier from a screenplay by Dan Mazeau and Justin Lin, both of whom also co-wrote the story with Zach Dean. The sequel to F9 (2021), it is the tenth main installment and the eleventh installment overall in the Fast & Furious franchise. It stars Vin Diesel as Dominic Toretto, alongside Michelle Rodriguez, Tyrese Gibson, Chris "Ludacris" Bridges, John Cena, Nathalie Emmanuel, Jordana Brewster, Sung Kang, Scott Eastwood, Daniela Melchior, Alan Ritchson, Helen Mirren, Brie Larson, Rita Moreno, Jason Statham, Jason Momoa, and Charlize Theron.
